decisions.reason: A navigation and observation camera close to the core offer has a dedicated page and costs little to keep, while its value in long space procurement cycles is still uncertain, so the option is worth holding.
The modular camera line has reported flight heritage (the HERA launch), so its option is resolving positively and justifies further commitment.
Space situational awareness is a growing market with still-uncertain prospects, and the suite builds on existing competencies at low carrying cost, so keeping the option makes sense.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned and has no visible results, but it fits the strategic push toward compact sensors for small satellites, so its uncertain upside still justifies the modest cost of keeping it.
The radiation-hard camera line was launched recently with a dedicated page, and its uncertainty has not resolved yet, so dropping it would forfeit the option.
The asteroid camera is tied to missions like HERA where the firm has proven performance, and its niche value is uncertain but cheap to keep available.
